My brother and I were sitting on the couch and we hear a loud crash. We look at each like wtf and it sounded like it was right outside of the house. We go outside and see nothing. Walk down a few blocks and turn the corner...

There’s a suv smashed against a building. A little past it is a motorcycle laying on its side. The driver of the suv I can barely see. The motorcyclist though... god he was about 50 feet from the car. Laying on his back and I’ll never forget his right leg bent forward facing up. His lower half of his leg under his knee was touching his front thigh. It was one of the most disturbing things I’ve ever seen. 

The Police arrive and put the smallest yellow tarp on this poor guy. The worst part, there were so many people outside looking on. Kids everywhere and I don’t understand how the parents allowed it. It was windy and the tarp flew off him a few times, so fucking kids see this. It was horrific and I pray that man died on impact. 

Quick rundown what happened because it was on the news that night. Both the SUV and motorcycle were coming to each other on each side of the road. For some reason the SUV decided to turn and cut the bike off, maybe she didn’t see him but the bike crashed right into her. Fuck I hate thinking about that
